IncidentLog.title: IncidentLog
IncidentLog.description: A saved emergency triage session, multimodal scene scan assessment, or multi-incident responder brief owned by a signed-in user.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

promptSummary.description: User scenario or visual question summary (1-1200 chars).

guidanceSummary.description: Primary structured guidance or handoff report body (1-6000 chars).

checklistSteps.description: Bounded list of up to 25 actionable checklist step strings.

doNotDoNotes.description: Optional warning notes of actions to avoid (0-1500 chars).

inferenceSource.description: Actual Firebase AI Logic inference source reported by SDK.

latencyMs.description: Measured wall-clock inference latency in milliseconds.

platform.description: Client platform originating the incident log (ANDROID or WEB).

TelemetryEntry.title: TelemetryEntry
TelemetryEntry.description: Immutable hybrid AI routing decision record synced for the authenticated user.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

taskType.description: Label for the AI workflow (1-80 chars).

actualSource.description: Actual response.inferenceSource returned by Firebase AI Logic.

promptChars.description: Character count of prompt sent to HybridAIRouter.

routingReason.description: Explanation for mode selection or cloud fallback (1-300 chars).

/users/{userId}/incidents/{incidentId}.description: Per-user offline-capable emergency incident logs and responder briefs.

/users/{userId}/telemetry/{logId}.description: Per-user hybrid AI routing decision telemetry logs.
